items.q: And this Indian fella, he come to be a friend of mine, he took me to a cabaret in --when the carnival got to Detroit.

ctx.x: Superior Shows. Who were some of the performers that were in that carnival with you? Do you remember any of them?
Oh, I'd have to fish back to think about them. There was about eight or nine different ones. They had a fella in there that put me in the cabaret, his name was Kid Fox, and, oh, I can't think of --
What did this carnival consist of, the part that you -- the black show?

items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And this Indian fella, he come to be a friend of mine, he took me to a cabaret in --when the carnival got to Detroit.

ctx.x: And after being with the carnival maybe two or three months -- there was a fella in there they called Kid Fox, he was an Indian. He wanted to see me get a better break than this carnival, 'cause I was much too good for the carnival because the man that run the carnival, he was a nice guy, nice guy, but he'd give you peanuts instead of chocolates. If you take the peanuts, didn't know no more than the peanuts, you don't know no more than the peanuts. You don't know what the chocolates tasted like.

And this Indian fella, he come to be a friend of mine, he took me to a cabaret in --when the carnival got to Detroit. He took me to this cabaret to do an audition. He'd get me there and let them see me sing. That's all he wanted to do. He did and that put me in the cabaret division. Now, not the carnival now, cabaret division. 'Cause I go in the cabaret, man, I tore the cabaret down. I used to make so much money in the cabaret, people throwing money and all. However, I played two cabarets at once, one right…
